title: LumiumX automation product.json (primary machine-readable source of truth)

edge.description: safe-margin: clear margin on every side; full-bleed: artwork runs to the edges

format_notes.description: One sentence of format-specific composition guidance, e.g. space reserved for invitation wording, or writing space on a planner page

adopted_after_restart.description: PNG was written before a crash but not yet recorded; reused instead of paying again

page_type.description: e.g. cover, colouring, maze, counting, tracing, matching, word-search, certificate

instructions.description: Child-facing instructions printed on the page, or null

generation_prompt.description: Page-specific image prompt; the shared visual system is added by code

purpose.description: Crochet only (ADR-047): concept-style = made before the patterns exist (sets the look, never evidence of a specific pattern's result); traceable-product = made after Restyle from pattern-derived, checked visual specs.

outcome.description: ok: call succeeded; api_error: the call failed; rejected: billed output failed local validation

engine.description: Stage 3 marketing engine chosen by the owner for this run (stored for reproducibility).

approved_hero.description: ADR-065: the hero comparison candidate this choice approved, referenced by SHA-256 (the comparison entry is the source of truth).

route.description: ADR-064: the structured route contract this hero followed (routes.mjs routeOf).

brief.description: ADR-064: the scene brief the hero environment was made from (compared by the pre-image route gate).

route.description: ADR-064: the structured route contract this hero followed (routes.mjs routeOf).

brief.description: ADR-064: the scene brief the hero environment was made from (compared by the pre-image route gate).

etsy.description: Stage 4 summary. Full records live in products/<id>/etsy/ (payload, draft, uploads, verification, publish-record, api-activity). Never holds credentials.

override_history.description: ADR-067: every owner-approved overflow exception accepted for this product (audit; never removed).

size.description: Requested pixel size (the largest the image model supports for the canvas orientation). Actual pixel sizes are recorded per page.

override.description: ADR-067: owner-approved exception for decorative artwork overflow (rule artwork-edge-overflow only), bound to the QC report SHA-256 and pages fingerprint.
ADR-067: owner-approved exception for decorative artwork overflow (rule artwork-edge-overflow only), bound to the QC report SHA-256 and pages fingerprint.

book.description: Stage 1 full-book artwork for full-book formats (colouring books, ADR-030). Stage 2 accepts the product only with approval bound to the manifest, page checksums and a passing QC report.

crochet_visuals.description: Crochet VISUAL SET (ADR-063): one collection hero + one finished-item preview per approved pattern, generated (paid, owner-confirmed, image by image, resumable) from code-built briefs bound to the approved patterns' fingerprints. Stage 2 requires approval bound to the visual manifest and every file's SHA-256 once a set exists. Illustrations, never photographs of test-crocheted items.

restyles.description: Crochet RESTYLE records (ADR-044): each one cleared the creative (style) approval and archived the previous direction, pages and approval record. Pattern approval is never changed by a restyle.

visual_specs.description: Pattern-derived visual specs the restyled briefs were built from (ADR-046).

visual_match_status.description: physically_verified is never set by code: it needs a person to crochet the pattern and confirm the result.

crochet.description: Stage 1 crochet pattern content (ADR-041), a gate separate from creative approval. Candidate patterns (AI-assisted drafts, or an owner-supplied source) are validated by production/src/crochet/bundle.mjs and reviewed; APPROVE PATTERNS binds the approval to the exact SHA-256 of crochet/patterns.json. Approval for production is never testing or verification.

guidance.description: The owner's collection guidance (e.g. flower families), passed to the plan call. Creative guidance only, not a requirement list.

unprintable.description: Characters the document fonts cannot print (ADR-052), for the owner's concise review message.

approval_history.description: Earlier pattern approvals superseded because crochet/patterns.json was edited after approval (ADR-052). Audit only; never used to approve.
